banner.title: End-to-End Encryption
banner.desc: This conversation is end-to-end encrypted; the server cannot read its contents

unverified.title: {count} unverified device(s) in this room
unverified.desc: These devices will not receive this room's encrypted messages. By default keys are still sent to them (for interoperability with clients such as Element); you can also send only to verified devices.
unverified.strict_on_desc: Strict mode is on: this room's keys are only sent to verified devices, so {count} device(s) currently receive nothing. This only affects messages sent from now on — keys already shared cannot be recalled.
unverified.query_failed_desc: The device list for this room is temporarily unavailable, so it is unknown whether unverified devices exist.
